title: mariscus hypochlorus
intro: Mariscus hypochlorus, commonly known as "Khadira", is a type of plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae, native to tropical regions. The health benefits of Mariscus hypochlorus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Mariscus hypochlorus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
